description: This PHP source file defines the CorporateDirectoryModuleController class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing the corporate directory module's server-side logic, including dependency management and preparing data for rendering the client-side component.

classes.name: CorporateDirectoryModuleController
classes.description: Controller class managing the corporate directory module, extending AbstractVueController to interface with Vue.js components, providing data like job titles and locations to the client side.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance used to fetch job titles.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with job titles and locations data before rendering the view.
